📦 Shipping Policy

Order Processing
All orders are processed within 1–3 business days after payment confirmation. Orders are not shipped on weekends or public holidays.

Shipping Time
Delivery typically takes 3–10 business days across India depending on your location.

Shipping Charges
Shipping charges are calculated and displayed at checkout before payment.

Order Tracking
Once your order is shipped, tracking details will be sent via Email, SMS, or WhatsApp.

Delivery Delays
Delays may occasionally occur due to weather conditions, courier issues, public holidays, or unforeseen circumstances.

Incorrect Address
Customers are responsible for providing accurate shipping information. We are not responsible for delays caused by incorrect addresses.

Damaged or Lost Packages
If your package arrives damaged or is lost during transit, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery.

Contact Us
For any shipping-related questions, please contact our support team through WhatsApp or Email.
×

↩️ Return Policy

Return Window
Returns may be requested within 7 days of receiving your order.

Eligibility
Products must be unused, undamaged, and in their original packaging.

Damaged or Incorrect Items
If you receive a damaged, defective, or incorrect item, contact us within 48 hours of delivery.

Non-Returnable Items
Customized, personalized, and clearance-sale items are not eligible for return.

Return Approval
All return requests are reviewed before approval.

Refund Process
Approved refunds will be processed within 5–10 business days to the original payment method.

Shipping Charges
Original shipping charges are non-refundable unless the return is due to our error.

Contact Us
For return-related questions, please contact us via WhatsApp or Email.
